sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS SURROUNDING THE MDT RISK FROM CNTRL NJ TO ERN MS...

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ...POTENTIALLY SIGNIFICANT SEVERE THUNDERSTORM EVENT POSSIBLE ACROSS THE MIDDLE ATLANTIC THURSDAY...

sections.title: MIDDLE ATLANTIC
sections.text: WELL DEFINED SHORT-WAVE TROUGH IS DIGGING ESEWD ACROSS THE MIDWEST INTO THE OH VALLEY EARLY THIS MORNING. LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS A FOCUSED AREA OF HEIGHT FALLS WILL SPREAD ACROSS THE OH VALLEY INTO THE MIDDLE ATLANTIC REGION DURING THE DAY WITH TROUGH AXIS EXPECTED TO TRANSLATE TO A POSITION FROM WRN PA INTO ERN TN AT 13/00Z. A CORRIDOR OF 50KT+ MID LEVEL FLOW SHOULD SPREAD ACROSS WV INTO THE DELMARVA BY SUNRISE ENHANCING DEEP LAYER SHEAR/MEAN WIND ACROSS MUCH OF THE EAST COAST...ESPECIALLY AREAS NORTH OF NC. GREATEST AREA OF CONCERN WILL EXTEND ACROSS VA INTO THE DELMARVA REGION WHERE LOW LEVEL SHEAR PROFILES ARE EXPECTED TO BE MOST FAVORABLE FOR POTENTIAL TORNADO DEVELOPMENT. EARLY THIS MORNING AN EXPANSIVE AND MATURE MCS HAS EVOLVED AHEAD OF THE SHORT-WAVE TROUGH OVER LOWER MI/NRN IND/OH...WITH A WELL DEFINED MCS APPROACHING THE WRN END OF LAKE ERIE. LEADING EDGE OF THIS MCS IS SURGING ESEWD AT ROUGHLY 40KT WHICH WOULD ALLOW SQUALL LINE TO SPREAD EAST OF THE APPALACHIANS BY SUNRISE. LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE DOES NOT PROJECT THIS CONVECTIVE COMPLEX EAST OF THE MOUNTAINS EARLY IN THE PERIOD AND CONSIDERABLE UNCERTAINTY EXISTS WHETHER THIS ACTIVITY WILL DIE OFF OR PROGRESS OFF

sections.title: MS TO SC
sections.text: FARTHER SOUTH ALONG TRAILING COLD FRONT...SFC TEMPERATURES ARE EXPECTED TO SOAR QUICKLY THROUGH THE 80S INTO THE LOWER 90S ACROSS THE CNTRL GULF STATES INTO SC. AS A RESULT...STEEP SFC-3KM LAPSE RATES WILL BE NOTED ACROSS THIS REGION PRIOR TO CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. WITH NWLY FLOW EXPECTED TO DEEPEN/STRENGTHEN UPSTREAM ACROSS THE TN VALLEY THERE IS LITTLE REASON TO DOUBT STORMS THAT FORM ALONG THE COLD FRONT WILL PROPAGATE SEWD INTO REGION OF MODEST INSTABILITY/STEEP LAPSE RATES. DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY CONCERN WITH CONVECTION THAT DEVELOPS LATE IN THE AFTERNOON AND SPREADS SEWD DURING THE EVENING HOURS.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: STRONG MID LEVEL SHORT-WAVE TROUGH IS EXPECTED TO SPREAD ACROSS THE INTERIOR NWRN U.S. INTO THE NRN ROCKIES LATE IN THE PERIOD. DIFFLUENT HIGH LEVEL FLOW IN CONJUNCTION WITH LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG LEE TROUGH WILL AID SCT TSTM DEVELOPMENT FROM ERN MT INTO SERN WY. FORECAST DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS MORE THAN ADEQUATE FOR SUSTAINED DEEP ROTATING UPDRAFTS AND SUPERCELL STRUCTURES ARE EXPECTED ACROSS THE SLGT RISK REGION. STRONG HEATING SHOULD PROVE INSTRUMENTAL IN TSTM INITIATION AND LARGE HAIL/STRONG WINDS ARE THE PRIMARY CONCERN WITH THIS DIURNALLY INITIATED ACTIVITY. ..DARROW/ROGERS.. 06/13/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A SIGNIFICANT UPPER TROUGH CURRENTLY ALONG THE PACIFIC COAST APPEARS LIKELY TO ACCELERATE INLAND TODAY...AND NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE GREAT BASIN...TOWARD THE NORTHERN ROCKIES BY LATE TONIGHT...AS ANOTHER SIGNIFICANT IMPULSE DIGS UPSTREAM...ACROSS THE EASTERN PACIFIC. AS THIS OCCURS...SHARP UPPER RIDGING ACROSS THE PLAINS INTO THE CANADIAN PRAIRIES MAY BEGIN TO WEAKEN SOME...PARTICULARLY EAST OF THE NORTHERN ROCKIES INTO THE NORTHERN PLAINS. AT THE SAME TIME...UPPER RIDGING MAY BROADEN EASTWARD THROUGH THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...AS A SHORT WAVE TROUGH DIGS SOUTHEAST OF THE GREAT LAKES REGION...AND CONSOLIDATES WITH ANOTHER IMPULSE...NOW TURNING EASTWARD THROUGH THE OHIO VALLEY...TO FORM A LARGER SCALE AMPLIFYING UPPER TROUGH ACROSS THE MIDDLE AND SOUTH ATLANTIC COAST STATES BY 12Z FRIDAY. IN RESPONSE TO THESE LATTER DEVELOPMENTS...A DEEPENING SURFACE LOW IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE MIGRATING EAST SOUTHEASTWARD ALONG A STALLED SURFACE FRONT...FROM THE LOWER GREAT LAKES REGION THROUGH THE NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC COAST REGION. AT THE SAME TIME...A TRAILING COLD FRONT WILL CONTINUE ITS SOUTHWARD ADVANCEMENT...FROM THE LOWER OHIO/MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY AND CENTRAL PLAINS INTO THE GULF

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC COAST STATES/CUMBERLAND PLATEAU/SOUTHEAST
sections.text: A WEAKENING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...NOW EAST OF THE ALLEGHENY MOUNTAINS...MAY CONTINUE TO BE ACCOMPANIED BY A RISK FOR POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AS IT PROGRESSES THROUGH NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC COASTAL AREAS BY MID TO LATE MORNING. THE STABILIZING INFLUENCE OF THIS ACTIVITY...AND ASSOCIATED OUTFLOW...IS BEGINNING TO CONTRIBUTE TO MORE UNCERTAINTY CONCERNING POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL STRONG/SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE MID ATLANTIC COAST REGION LATER TODAY. BUT...A NEW CLUSTER OF STORMS APPEARS TO BE EVOLVING NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF THE STALLED OUTFLOW ASSOCIATED WITH THE LEAD CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...AND THE SOUTHWARD ADVANCING COLD FRONT...TO THE WEST OF THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS. FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH THE MID LEVEL IMPULSE ACROSS THE OHIO VALLEY IS AIDING THIS ACTIVITY...AND IS EXPECTED TO SPREAD TOWARD THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS THROUGH MIDDAY. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THIS NEW CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT OVER THE OHIO VALLEY WILL CONTINUE TO SLOWLY INTENSIFY...WITH AN INCREASING RISK FOR SEVERE WIND AND HAIL...AS IT PROGRESSES THROUGH AN UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT TOWARD THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS. THEREAFTER ...IT IS NOT CLEAR IF THIS CONVECTION WILL MAINTAIN INTENSITY AND PROGRESS E

sections.title: NORTHERN/CENTRAL ROCKIES AND HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: DESPITE SOMEWHAT MODEST MOISTURE...INSTABILITY ASSOCIATED WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL PROBABLY BE SUFFICIENT FOR A SCATTERING OF SEVERE STORMS ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. THIS WILL BE AIDED BY FORCING AHEAD OF THE APPROACHING UPPER TROUGH...AND STRONG SOUTHWESTERLY MID/UPPER FLOW...WHICH WILL CONTRIBUTE TO SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS. ..KERR.. 06/13/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: HIGHLY AMPLIFIED FLOW REGIME WILL SUPPORT A CONTINUATION OF ACTIVE SEVERE WEATHER ACROSS BOTH THE EAST AND WEST TODAY.

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC TO DEEP SOUTH
sections.text: A PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH ACCOMPANIED BY 40-50KT MID-LEVEL JET STREAK WILL CONTINUE TO DIG EAST-SOUTHEAST ACROSS CENTRAL APPALACHIANS TO THE MID ATLANTIC REGION THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. THIS SYSTEM IS LENDING SUPPORT TO SURFACE LOW PRESSURE CENTER THAT WAS LOCATED NEAR THE NY/PA BORDER WITH A COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWWD TO CNTRL KY AND THEN WWD TO THE SRN PLAINS. WITH MORNING MCS NOW OFF THE JERSEY SHORE...FOCUS FOR MORE WIDESPREAD SEVERE STORMS HAS SHIFTED SOUTH TO VA/NC AND POINTS SOUTH AND WEST. LEADING MCS DEPARTING THE JERSEY SHORE HAS GENERATED AN E-W ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY LOCATED FROM DE/ERN MD INTO CNTRL/NRN VA AND WV. TEMPERATURES S OF THE OUTFLOW ARE WARMING WELL INTO THE 80S OVER CNTRL/SRN VA AND NRN NC. THIS HEATING COMBINED WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE 70S AND COOL MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES/STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL YIELD STRONG TO LOCALLY EXTREME INSTABILITY DURING THE AFTERNOON. ONCE ACROSS THE APPALACHIAN SPINE...EXPECT STORMS TO CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN VIGOR WHILE DEVELOPING ESEWD SUPPORTED BY LARGE SCALE ASCENT AND STRENGTHENING SHEAR COINCIDENT WITH DIURNAL MAXIMUM IN DESTABILIZATION. GIVEN STRENGTHENING WLY FLOW ALOFT AND MAGNITUDE OF INSTAB

sections.title: ROCKIES FRONT RANGE TO CENTRAL TO NORTH HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: A POTENT UPPER TROUGH OVER THE PACIFIC NW WILL MIGRATE EWD TOWARDS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS THROUGH FRIDAY MORNING. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A LEAD DISTURBANCE MOVING NEWD ACROSS UT AND THIS FEATURE WILL MOVE ACROSS WY AND APPROACH SERN MT BY THE LATE AFTERNOON. ALTHOUGH THE NRN-CNTRL HIGH PLAINS ARE LARGELY REMOVED FROM GREATER MOISTURE CONFINED FARTHER S OVER THE SRN PLAINS...ADEQUATE PW /0.7-1.0 INCH/ IN COMBINATION WITH VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES AND FORCING FOR ASCENT /DCVA/HEIGHT FALLS/ WILL LEAD TO ISOLD-WIDELY SCTD STORMS DEVELOPING BY THE AFTERNOON. STRONG/DEEP SWLY WIND PROFILES WILL PROMOTE STORM ORGANIZATION WHERE DEWPOINTS CAN REMAIN IN THE UPPER 40S-MID 50S. INITIALLY ISOLATED HIGH-BASED CONVECTION IS FORECAST TO EXPAND IN AREAL COVERAGE AND MOVE DOWNSTREAM FROM WRN WY NEWD INTO ERN WY/SRN MT. ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PREDOMINATE THREAT WITH STORMS LOCATED FARTHER W IN DRIER/DEEPLY MIXED AIRMASS. WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP FARTHER E ALONG LEE TROUGH EXTENDING FROM A WEAK LOW OVER SERN MT INTO ERN CO. FORECAST SOUNDINGS OVER SERN MT/NERN WY SHOW MODERATE INSTABILITY 1000-2000 J/KG MLCAPE AND STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR...SUPPORTIVE OF ISOLATED SU

sections.title: SOUTHEASTERN U.S
sections.text: NWLY FLOW WILL CONTINUE TO DEEPEN ACROSS THE ERN U.S. THROUGH THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. THIS WILL ENSURE SFC FRONT PROGRESSES ACROSS MUCH OF THE GULF STATES AND OFF THE CAROLINA COAST BY 14/12Z. SCT TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG THE WIND SHIFT WITHIN AN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MODERATE INSTABILITY. 00Z SOUNDINGS AT BMX/FFC/CHS ALL DEPICT SBCAPE IN EXCESS OF 3000 J/KG WITH SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR TO SUPPORT CONTINUED SEVERE THREAT DEEP INTO THE EVENING HOURS. PRIMARY CHANGES TO THE 01Z OUTLOOK ACROSS THIS REGION WERE TO REDUCE SEVERE PROBABILITIES BEHIND THE FRONTAL CONVECTION.

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ESELY BOUNDARY LAYER FLOW IS WELL ESTABLISHED ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS FROM NWRN KS INTO ERN MT. ISOLATED SUPERCELLS HAVE EVOLVED OFF THE NRN ROCKIES...PRIMARILY OVER SCNTRL MT. ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS REMAIN QUITE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS ACROSS THIS REGION AND WITH LLJ EXPECTED TO INCREASE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS IT WOULD SEEM REASONABLE THAT THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD SPREAD TO NEAR THE DAKOTA BORDER BEFORE WEAKENING. VERY LARGE HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY DISCRETE SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. 00Z SOUNDINGS FROM BOTH RAP AND LBF EXHIBITED A VERY STRONG CAP THUS STRONGEST CONVECTION SHOULD HOLD ACROSS MT/ERN WY INTO NERN CO. ..DARROW.. 06/14/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONTINUE WWS ALONG/AHEAD OF PRIMARY MCS...WHICH WAS LOCATED AT 12Z FROM E-CENTRAL PA TO NEAR FDK THEN WSWWD TO S-CENTRAL WV NEAR CRW. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD MOVE GENERALLY ESEWD...OFFERING OCNL GUSTS NEAR SVR LIMITS. MAIN HAZARD WILL REMAIN WIND DAMAGE...ESPECIALLY INVOLVING TREES AND POWER LINES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOST WELL-ORGANIZED PART OF MCS WAS EVIDENT ASTRIDE MD/PA BORDER...GENERALLY ALONG AND S OF SFC WARM-FRONTAL ZONE THAT WAS ANALYZED ROUGHLY ACROSS PHL/ACY AREAS THEN SEWD OVER ATLC. WARM FRONT SHOULD MOVE NWD IN ADVANCE OF THIS ACTIVITY...AND IS SHALLOW ENOUGH FOR RISK OF STG/DAMAGING GUSTS TO REACH SFC WITHIN 50-75 NM TO ITS N AS WELL. PRECONVECTIVE WARM SECTOR WILL REMAIN CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEW POINTS UPPER 60S TO MID 70S F...ACTING IN TANDEM WITH POCKETS OF SFC DIABATIC HEATING TO INCREASE BUOYANCY. MLCAPE JUST PRIOR TO TSTM ARRIVAL SHOULD RANGE FROM AROUND 1000 /KG ALONG WARM FRONT TO 2500-3000 J/KG RANGE IN CENTRAL VA...ALONG N END OF MODIFIED EML EVIDENT IN 12Z RNK RAOB THAT WILL STEEPEN LAPSE RATES WITH SWD EXTENT. DEEP SHEAR WILL REMAIN MAXIMIZED N OF VA/NC BORDER...WITH 45-55 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES FROM WARM FRONT TO N-CENTRAL VA. ALTHOUGH SVR THREAT FROM PRIMARY MCS CURRENTLY DIMINISHES WITH WWD EXTENT INTO WV...RISK MAY INCREASE AGAIN FROM TWO PERSPECTIVES... 1. RE-INTENSIFICATION OF ACTIVITY MOVING FROM CENTRAL/SRN WV EWD INTO WRN/CENTRAL VA...AND INTO DESTABILIZING AIR MASS. 2. UPSHEAR CONVECTION BECOMING BETTER ORGANIZED ACROSS SERN INDIANA AND MOVING ESEWD ALONG OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM INITIAL MCS. FOR MORE DETAILS ON THIS SCENARIO...REF SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1058 FORTHCOMING. ..EDWARDS.. 06/13/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS MAY CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THROUGH THE MORNING. SEVERE WIND AND HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT AND WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE LATER THIS MORNING IF CURRENT TRENDS CONTINUE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 12Z WV IMAGERY DEPICTS A COMPACT VORT MAX MOVING FROM INDIANA INTO WRN OH. AHEAD OF THIS SYSTEM...CONVECTION HAS INCREASED IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY OVER THE LAST 1-2 HRS NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF THE REMNANT NW-SE ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM THE PREVIOUS CONVECTIVE SYSTEM AND A SWWD TRAILING COLD FRONT NOW PUSHING THROUGH SRN IL/IND. STRONG UNIDIRECTIONAL FLOW IN THE 3-6 KM LAYER IS SUPPORTING EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 45-55 KTS DOWNSTREAM OF THIS ACTIVITY...WHILE RISING TEMPS ALREADY NEAR 80F ACROSS SRN IND INTO KY IS RESULTING IN MODERATE MUCAPE OF 1500-2500 J/KG PER RECENT MESOANALYSIS. THIS ENVIRONMENT WILL FAVOR CONTINUED INTENSIFICATION OF ONGOING CONVECTION...WITH AN INCREASING RISK FOR DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL AS FURTHER DESTABILIZATION OCCURS DOWNSTREAM. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE IN THE NEXT 1-2 HRS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS...LARGE HAIL...AND POSSIBLY AN ISOLATED TORNADO WILL INCREASE ACROSS ERN WV...VA...CNTRL/ERN MD...DE...NRN NC...AND NERN TN FROM MIDDAY INTO THE EVENING HOURS. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL BE ISSUED DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. IN ADDITION...PORTIONS OF DELMARVA INTO NRN/CNTRL NC WILL BE UPGRADED TO A MODERATE RISK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS MOVING ACROSS THE MID OH VALLEY LATE THIS MORNING...WITH 40+ KT MIDLEVEL WLYS SPREADING DOWNSTREAM ACROSS THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS INTO THE MID ATLANTIC REGION. AT THE SURFACE...LOW PRESSURE IS LOCATED OVER NRN PA/WRN NY...WITH A COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWWD ACROSS CNTRL KY. IN ADDITION...MORNING MCS EXITING OFFSHORE OVER NJ HAS LAID OUT AN E-W ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY LOCATED FROM DE/ERN MD INTO CNTRL/NRN VA AND WV. TEMPERATURES S OF THE OUTFLOW ARE WARMING WELL INTO THE 80S OVER CNTRL/SRN VA AND NRN NC. THIS HEATING COMBINED WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE 70S AND COOL MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES/STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL YIELD STRONG INSTABILITY DURING THE AFTERNOON...WITH MLCAPE VALUES AOA 3000 J/KG. THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS STARTING TO DESTABILIZE FROM THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS EWD INTO CNTRL VA...WHICH IS EXPECTED TO ALLOW STORMS FORMING OVER WV...AS WELL AS SQUALL LINE MOVING ESEWD AT 35-40 KT OVER KY...TO SPREAD E OF THE MOUNTAINS DURING THE AFTERNOON. STRONG WLY FLOW ALOFT WILL SUPPORT MAINLY UNIDIRECTIONAL SHEAR PROFILES FAVORABLE FOR BOWING LINE SEGMENTS AND SUPERCELLS. DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREATS...BUT AN ISOLATED TORNADO IS ALSO POSSIBLE ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL CONTINUES FOR WW 305 OVER CNTRL/ERN KY AND WRN/CNTRL WV.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY AT 1545Z SHOWS A SQUALL LINE LOCATED FROM FAR WRN WV SWWD INTO CNTRL KY IS MOVING ESEWD AT 35-40 KT. CELLULAR ACTIVITY IS DEVELOPING AHEAD OF THE LINE OVER FAR ERN KY INTO SRN WV. AIRMASS ACROSS THE AREA IS SLOWLY WARMING THROUGH THE 70S DESPITE THE PRESENCE OF WIDESPREAD STRATO-CUMULUS CLOUD COVER. TONGUE OF UPPER 60S TO LOW 70S DEWPOINTS EXTENDS NEWD AHEAD OF THE SQUALL LINE AS WELL...WHICH IS AIDING IN MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE VALUES FROM 1000-2000 J/KG. THUS...GIVEN THE GRADUALLY IMPROVING THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT COMBINED WITH VERY FAVORABLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR PROFILES...SEVERE WEATHER THREAT WILL CONTINUE FOR WW 305...MAINLY IN THE FORM OF DAMAGING WINDS WITH THE SQUALL LINE...AND SOME HAIL/DAMAGING WIND THREAT WITH THE PRE SQUALL LINE CELLULAR ACTIVITY. ..GARNER.. 06/13/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS ACROSS TN AND SPREAD E AND S INTO ADJACENT STATES. WIND DAMAGE WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD WITH THE EXPECTED ACTIVITY...AND ISOLD LARGE HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 17Z SURFACE MESOANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT DRAPED ACROSS ERN KY WSWWD THROUGH THE KY/MO/TN BORDER VICINITY. VISIBLE SATELLITE SHOWS A CU FIELD BECOMING AGITATED WITHIN SEVERAL TRANSVERSE BANDS/GRAVITY WAVES PROPAGATING SEWD ACROSS THE TN VALLEY --INDICATIVE OF A DESTABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER. THE 12Z BNA RAOB SHOWS A VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS IN PLACE AND MODIFYING FOR EXPECTED TEMPS IN MID 80S TO LOWER 90S GREATLY DIMINISHES CINH AND EFFECTIVELY ERODES THE REMAINING CAP. ALTHOUGH LOW LEVEL CONFLUENCE IS FOCUSES FARTHER NE INTO FAR NERN TN/SWRN VA...HEATING AND THE TRAILING INFLUENCE OF THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS UPPER TROUGH WILL LIKELY INITIATE STORMS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...ZIPPERING SWWD WITH TIME. STRONG WLY FLOW IN THE 2-4 KM LAYER /40 KT/ AT KHTX AND KOHX AND STEEPENING LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT DOWNWARD MOMENTUM TRANSPORT IN THE FORM OF DMGG WIND GUSTS ONCE ROBUST UPDRAFTS DEVELOP/INTENSIFY. STRONGER LOW-MID LEVEL WLY FLOW IS NOTED AT KMRX /50 KT AT 2 KM/...SIGNALING A HIGHER CONCENTRATION FOR DMGG STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS. AT LEAST SOME POSSIBILITY FOR A TORNADO MAY EXIST DUE TO THE STRENGTH OF FLOW. AS SUCH...STORMS WILL LIKELY CONSOLIDATE INTO A LOOSE CONGLOMERATION OF SMALL LINE SEGMENTS/BOWS AS THE MOVE EWD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS AND LINE SEGMENTS WILL ENTER PORTIONS OF SERN VA AND NERN NC THIS AFTERNOON. AS THIS OCCURS...THE THREAT FOR WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL INCREASE. WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY AFTERNOON SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS GUIDANCE INDICATE THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS SERN VA AND ERN NC IS BECOMING STRONGLY UNSTABLE...WITH TEMPERATURES NEAR 90F AND DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 70S AIDING IN MLCAPE VALUES FROM 2500-4000 J/KG. AREA VWP/S SHOW MAINLY DEEP-LAYER WLY FLOW INCREASING TO 50 KT AT 3 KM AGL. GIVEN THIS COMBINATION OF CAPE AND SHEAR...NUMEROUS MULTICELL CLUSTERS/LINE SEGMENTS AND A FEW SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE AS A COLD FRONT APPROACHES FROM THE W. THESE STORMS WILL POSE A THREAT FOR WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. AREA WILL NEED A WW ISSUANCE DURING THE NEXT HOUR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: HIGH-BASED STORMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO DEVELOP/INTENSIFY ACROSS SWRN WY AND MOVE NEWD OVER CNTRL WY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THE PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE MICROBURSTS CAPABLE OF ISOLD SEVERE WIND GUSTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 18Z SURFACE OBSERVATIONS SHOW TEMPS RISING INTO THE UPPER 70S AND LOWER 80S ACROSS SWRN-CNTRL WY IMMEDIATELY DOWNSTREAM OF AN MID-LEVEL VORTICITY MAXIMUM FORECAST TO MOVE ACROSS WRN-CNTRL PORTIONS OF WY DURING THE AFTERNOON. FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THIS IMPULSE WILL CONTINUE TO PROMOTE STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THE KRIW VWP SHOWS STRONG SWLY MID-HIGH LEVEL FLOW INCREASING FROM 30 KT AT 3 KM ARL TO 70 KT AT 6 KM ARL. AS STORMS CONTINUE TO MOVE NEWD INTO HIGHER PW AIR OVER CNTRL WY...THE PROPENSITY FOR STORMS TO BE CAPABLE OF MICROBURSTS AND ISOLD SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL SEEMINGLY INCREASE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WEATHER THREAT FOR WW 306 CONTINUES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND LINES CONTINUE TO MOVE ESE AT UP TO 40 KT OVER PORTIONS OF WRN/CNTRL VA AND FAR ERN WV. SKIES HAVE CLEARED DOWNSTREAM FROM THIS ACTIVITY...WITH TEMPERATURES WARMING INTO THE 90S AND DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO LOW 70S. THIS SURFACE AIRMASS IS INDICATIVE OF A STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT...WITH MLCAPE VALUES RANGING FROM 2000 J/KG OVER CNTRL VA TO 4000 J/KG IN SERN VA. IN ADDITION...WIND PROFILES ARE MORE THAN ADEQUATE FOR ORGANIZED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT...WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES NEAR 50 KT. THESE CONDITIONS WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL THROUGH THE AFTERNOON ACROSS WW 306. ..GARNER.. 06/13/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIDELY SCTD STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE TO DEVELOP/INTENSIFY THIS AFTERNOON POSING AN ISOLD LARGE HAIL/SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT. A TORNADO THREAT MAY ALSO DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS SRN PORTIONS OF MT AND NERN WY WHEN THE SUPERCELL THREAT IS HIGHEST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC RECENTLY HAS SHOWN A SMALL CLUSTER OF INTENSE STORMS MOVING THROUGH THE GREATER KBIL VICINITY...PRODUCING GOLFBALL SIZE HAIL AND STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS. THE AIRMASS OVER THE ERN HALF OF MT AND THE ERN 1/3 OF WY IS SEASONABLY MOIST CHARACTERIZED BY LOWER TO MID 50S DEWPOINTS. VISIBLE SATELLITE SHOWS THIS REGION IS LARGELY VOID OF CLOUD COVER...WHICH SHOULD ACT TO PROMOTE STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING AND FURTHER DESTABILIZATION. THE WIND PROFILE VEERS FROM SELY AT THE SURFACE --HELPING TO MAINTAIN A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER-- TO STRONG/STRENGTHENING SWLY DEEP FLOW. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW UPWARDS OF 1000-2000 J/KG MLCAPE DEVELOPING ACROSS NERN WY INTO SERN MT WITH A SUPERCELL WIND PROFILE. IN ADDITION TO A LARGE TO VERY LARGE HAIL THREAT AND SEVERE WIND GUSTS...AN ISOLD TORNADO THREAT MAY DEVELOP PRIMARILY TOWARDS/DURING THE EVENING WHEN THE PROSPECTS FOR MULTIPLE DISCRETE SUPERCELLS APPEARS GREATEST.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS...INCLUDING A FEW SUPERCELLS...ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP OVER ERN CO DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS...AND THEN SPREAD DOWNSTREAM INTO PORTIONS OF THE FAR SRN NEB PANHANDLE...SWRN NEB...AND WRN KS. DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREATS WITH THIS ACTIVITY. AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONTAL BOUNDARY WAS ANALYZED FROM SERN CO INTO SERN WY AT 1845Z...WITH A DCVZ OBSERVED IN SURFACE OBSERVATIONS OVER NERN CO. ALONG AND W OF THE FRONT...THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS DESTABILIZING STRONGLY AS TEMPERATURES RISE INTO 70S AND 80S. E OF THE FRONT...A MOIST BUT SOMEWHAT STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER EXISTS...WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW TO MID 50S CAPPED BENEATH AN INVERSION CENTERED NEAR 750 MB. ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO EVOLVE OFF OF THE FRONT RANGE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS...AND EVENTUALLY MOVE E ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS AS THE ATMOSPHERE CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE THIS AFTERNOON. WIND PROFILES WILL BE CHARACTERIZED BY SELY LOW-LEVEL FLOW VEERING TO SWLY IN THE MIDLEVELS...WITH SPEEDS INCREASING TO 30-40 KT AT 6 KM AGL. THIS WIND PROFILE COMBINED WITH VERY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MLCAPE VALUES INCREASING TO 1000-2000 J/KG LATER THIS AFTERNOON WILL FAVOR STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS AND A FEW SUPERCELLS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREATS. LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING...STORMS ARE FORECAST TO ADVANCE INTO PORTIONS OF SWRN NEB AND WRN KS...POSSIBLY IN THE FORM OF A SMALL MCS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS AND LINE SEGMENTS ARE FORECAST TO ENTER CNTRL SC AND ERN GA BY EARLY EVENING. AS THIS OCCURS...THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL INCREASE. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY AND LATEST SURFACE OBSERVATIONS SHOW STRONG HEATING OCCURRING ACROSS SC AND GA THIS AFTERNOON...WITH TEMPERATURES WARMING INTO THE MID 90S. THIS IS YIELDING STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION...WHILE SURFACE DEWPOINTS HAVE MANAGED TO HOLD AROUND 70F. AS A RESULT...ENVIRONMENT HAS BECOME STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE VALUES RANGING FROM 2000-3000 J/KG. AS AN UPPER TROUGH OVER THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS CONTINUES TO DIG SLIGHTLY...STORM CLUSTERS AND LINES OCCURRING ALONG AN ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT ARE FORECAST TO SPREAD SEWD INTO CNTRL SC AND ERN GA BY EARLY EVENING. DEEP-LAYER WLY FLOW WITH SPEEDS NEAR 40 KT IN THE 2-4 KM AGL LAYER WILL SUPPORT A CONTINUED THREAT OF ORGANIZED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT...AND WHEN COMBINED WITH THE STRONG INSTABILITY...WILL FAVOR A SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLD STORMS MAY YIELD A LOCALIZED DAMAGING WIND THREAT. A PERHAPS GREATER WIND DAMAGE THREAT COULD MATERIALIZE IF A CONVECTIVE LINE DEVELOPS OVER NRN AL/GA AND MOVES SEWD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A CU FIELD PERCOLATING FROM NRN MS ENEWD INTO NRN AL/GA AHEAD OF A COLD FRONTAL ZONE OVER SRN MIDDLE TN WWD INTO WRN TN. A MID-LEVEL TROUGH SITUATED OVER THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS /PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY/ WILL MOVE SEWD THROUGH THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES AND CAROLINAS THIS EVENING AND AWAY FROM AL/GA...THEREBY LENDING LESS LARGE-SCALE SUPPORT FOR ORGANIZED STRONG-SEVERE STORMS. SUBJECTIVE SURFACE MESOANALYSIS PLACES THE BACK EDGE OF THE CU FIELD CO-LOCATED WITH A WEAK PRE-FRONTAL WINDSHIFT AHEAD OF THE FRONT. THE DIFFUSE CHARACTER OF THE FRONT AND DISPLACEMENT OF THE WINDSHIFT FROM THE FRONT HAS LIMITED LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND MUCH IN THE WAY OF STORMS DEVELOPING FROM NEAR THE I-65 CORRIDOR AND LOCATIONS W. DESPITE THESE LIMITATIONS...SEVERAL MORE HOURS PRIOR TO THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING AND MODERATE 3 KM AGL WLY FLOW /30 KT AT KFFC AND KBMX VWPS/ WOULD AT LEAST LEND THE POSSIBILITY FOR A FEW ISOLD DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WITH THE MORE VIGOROUS STORMS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WEATHER THREAT CONTINUES FOR WW/S 306...307...AND 308.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINE OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS OCCURRING ALONG AND AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT EXTENDS FROM THE DELMARVA REGION SWWD INTO WRN NC...SERN TN...AND NRN AL/GA. ANOTHER STORM NE OF THE DC METRO AREA HAS SHOWN SUPERCELLULAR AND BOWING TENDENCIES DURING THE LAST HOUR. ACTIVITY OVER THE DELMARVA INTO WRN NC IS MORE PERPENDICULAR TO UPPER-LEVEL FLOW...AND THUS HAS FASTER FORWARD MOTION COMPARED TO ACTIVITY TRAILING TO THE SW...WHICH IS MORE PARALLEL TO UPPER FLOW. STRONG HEATING AND A MOIST AIRMASS EXISTS AHEAD OF ONGOING STORMS...WITH MLCAPE VALUES RANGING FROM 1500-3000 J/KG. IN ADDITION...SHEAR PROFILES ARE STRONG...WHICH FAVORS CONTINUED STORM ORGANIZATION. GIVEN THIS ENVIRONMENT...SEVERE WEATHER THREAT CONTINUES FOR REMAIN PORTIONS OF WW/S 306 AND 307...AND MUCH OF WW 308. ..GARNER.. 06/13/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL PERSIST ACROSS WW 309...ESPECIALLY ACROSS CNTRL/ERN MT. THE SVR THREAT COULD ALSO EXTEND E OF THE CURRENT WATCH AREA LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING...AND WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE NEW WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VISIBLE/RADAR LOOPS SHOW ISOLATED STRONG-SVR STORMS CURRENTLY FOCUSED ACROSS CNTRL MT INTO SERN MT/FAR NERN WY...WITH THE MOST PROMINENT STORM A RIGHT-MOVING SUPERCELL OVER SHERIDAN COUNTY WY AND APPROACHING POWDER RIVER COUNTY MT AND CAMPBELL COUNTY WY. THE LATTER STORM APPEARS TO BE POSITIONED JUST E OF A SFC TROUGH EXTENDING ACROSS ERN MT/WY...WITH AN UNSTABLE/MODERATELY MOIST DOWNSTREAM AIR MASS AND 20-30 MPH S-SELY SFC WINDS FAVORABLE FOR THIS STORM TO MAINTAIN INTENSITY IN THE SHORT TERM. IT IS UNCERTAIN WHETHER COVERAGE/INTENSITY OF CURRENT TSTM ACTIVITY EXTENDING E OF WW 309 WILL WARRANT ISSUANCE OF A NEW WW...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED. MORE ROBUST TOWERING CU/CB DEVELOPMENT HAS ALSO BEEN NOTED IN THE PAST 1-2 HRS ACROSS S-CNTRL MT. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD CONTINUE PROGRESSING EWD INTO A RELATIVELY UNPERTURBED AIR MASS ALONG/E OF THE SFC TROUGH...ACROSS S-CNTRL AND SERN MT. MODIFIED FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST ESTIMATED MLCAPE VALUES EXCEEDING 1500 J/KG...ALONG WITH AMPLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR...WILL CONTINUE TO BE FAVORABLE FOR A FEW SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL DEVELOP SWD INTO CNTRL AL AND EXTREME ECNTRL MS EARLY THIS EVENING. THE STRONGER STORMS MIGHT REMAIN CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LOCALLY STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL THROUGH 02Z. OVERALL THREAT DOES NOT APPEAR SUFFICIENT FOR A WW AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BROKEN LINE OF STORMS IS MOVING SWD THROUGH NCNTRL AL AT AROUND 25 KT. THE DOWNSTREAM ATMOSPHERE REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE OVER CNTRL AL WITH A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND 2500-3000 J/KG MLCAPE. HOWEVER...FORECAST SOUNDINGS FROM THE NAM AND RAP MODELS INDICATE AN INVERSION LAYER JUST ABOVE 700 MB THAT IS ALSO VERY DRY. TRENDS IN WV IMAGERY ALSO INDICATE A MID-UPPER LEVEL DRYING TENDENCY...MOST LIKELY DUE TO SUBSIDENCE. THE DRY INVERSION LAYER MAY SERVE TO DILUTE THE UPDRAFT PARCELS THROUGH ENTRAINMENT AND REDUCE OVERALL UPDRAFT STRENGTH. NWLY EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 25-30 KT WILL SUPPORT MOSTLY MULTICELLS AND WEAK MID LEVEL UPDRAFT ROTATION WITH A MODEST THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL. ACTIVITY SHOULD BEGIN AN OVERALL DECREASE BY 02Z AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZES WITH ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: BROKEN LINE OF TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO PROPAGATE N-NEWD AND WILL BEGIN MOVING OUT OF PARTS OF WW 310 WITHIN THE NEXT HR. THE PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE DMGG WIND GUSTS...ALTHOUGH ISOLATED INSTANCES OF LARGE HAIL AS WELL AS A TORNADO ARE POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS BROKEN LINE OF TSTMS ALONG A COLD POOL PROPAGATING N-NEWD TOWARDS NERN CO/SWRN NEB. DMGG WIND GUSTS REMAIN THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY...ALTHOUGH THIS POTENTIAL MAY BE SOMEWHAT LIMITED BY DISCONTINUOUS CHARACTER OF CONVECTION ALONG THE COLD POOL. A LESSER THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO MAY ALSO ACCOMPANY STRONGER/MORE DISCRETE TSTMS...GIVEN BACKED SELY SFC WINDS NOTED IN RECENT OBSERVATIONS. IT IS UNCERTAIN HOW LONG THIS LINE WILL BE ABLE TO MAINTAIN CURRENT INTENSITY DOWNSTREAM /INTO SWRN NEB/...WITH A SIGNIFICANT CAPPING INVERSION NOTED ON 13/00Z LBF SOUNDING. HOWEVER...DMGG WIND THREAT MAY EXTEND OUTSIDE CURRENT WW 310 FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT 1-2 HRS...AND COULD REQUIRE ISSUANCE OF A NEW WW IF CONVECTIVE TRENDS WARRANT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL THROUGH AT LEAST MID EVENING...ESPECIALLY FROM CNTRL GA INTO CNTRL SC.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BROKEN PRE-FRONTAL LINE OF STORMS CONTINUES SEWD AT AROUND 25 KT FROM NCTRL GA EWD THROUGH CNTRL SC AND ERN NC. EVENING RAOB DATA INDICATE THE ATMOSPHERE IS MODERATELY UNSTABLE IN WARM SECTOR WITH A NEAR DRY ADIABATIC SFC-850 LAPSE RATES AND 7-7.5 C/KM MID LEVEL LAPSE RATE. THE STORMS ARE EMBEDDED IN NWLY FLOW ALOFT WITH 30-35 KT 0-6 KM VERTICAL SHEAR. THIS ENVIRONMENT WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT MAINLY MULTICELL AND SOME MARGINAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES NEXT 2-3 HOURS. CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WILL INCREASE SOON AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER COOLS...SUGGESTING STORMS SHOULD BEGIN A GRADUAL DECREASE IN INTENSITY AFTER 03Z. ..DIAL.. 06/14/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED STRONG-SVR TSTMS CONTINUE TO AFFECT PORTIONS OF CNTRL/ERN MT. WW 309 IS SCHEDULED TO EXPIRE AT 0300Z...BUT MAY NEED TO BE LOCALLY EXTENDED...OR POSSIBLY REQUIRE ISSUANCE OF A NEW WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED TSTMS CONTINUE TO REGENERATE ACROSS CNTRL/ERN MT WITHIN A BROAD ZONE OF ASCENT AHEAD OF A PAC NW UPPER TROUGH. DESPITE SOME BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING OVER THE PAST COUPLE HRS...RADAR TRENDS INDICATE THAT THE POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS PERSISTS WITHIN THE STRONGEST CONVECTIVE CORES...WITH OCCASIONAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. ALTHOUGH INSTABILITY IS FORECAST TO SLOWLY DECREASE IN CONCERT WITH CONTINUED BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING...STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MODERATELY STRONG FLOW ALOFT COULD CONTINUE TO SUPPORT STRONG TO POSSIBLY SVR CONVECTION BEYOND THE WATCH EXPIRATION TIME. ADDITIONALLY...13/12Z NSSL-WRF AND 14/00Z SUGGESTS ADDITIONAL CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO REGENERATE ACROSS CNTRL/ERN MT AND MAY EVENTUALLY CONSOLIDATE INTO AN ORGANIZED LINE OVER THE HIGH PLAINS. THUS...THE NEED FOR A LOCAL EXTENSION IN TIME OF WW 309...OR POSSIBLY ISSUANCE OF A NEW WW...WILL CONTINUE TO BE ASSESSED PRIOR TO SCHEDULED EXPIRATION TIME OF 0300Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MAY POSE A LIMITED THREAT FOR ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL AS THEY MOVE SWD TOWARD COASTAL SC. THREAT DOES NOT APPEAR TO WARRANT A WW ISSUANCE...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BROKEN LINE OF MOSTLY MULTICELL STORMS LOCATED ACROSS CNTRL SC IS MOVING SWD AT AROUND 25 KT AND WILL APPROACH THE SRN BORDER OF WW 311 BY 0330Z. THE ATMOSPHERE SOUTH OF THE ONGOING ACTIVITY REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE. HOWEVER...THE 00Z RAOB FROM CHARLESTON SC SHOWS AN INVERSION JUST ABOVE 700 MB...AND SURFACE BASED CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WILL INCREASE SUBSTANTIALLY AS SFC LAYER BEGINS TO COOL. THE INCREASINGLY HOSTILE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT AND PRESENCE OF ONLY WEAK MESOSCALE FORCING SUGGEST THAT WHILE A FEW STORMS MAY PERSIST/REDEVELOP ALONG RESIDUAL CONVECTIVE OUTFLOWS AND POSE A MODEST SEVERE RISK NEXT HOUR OR TWO...OVERALL TENDENCY SHOULD BE FOR ACTIVITY TO UNDERGO A GRADUAL WEAKENING TREND.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM ACROSS ERN NEB...AND MAY POSE A LARGE HAIL THREAT AS THEY DEVELOP EWD INTO THE MO RIVER VALLEY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A WEAK MIDLEVEL FEATURE IS CURRENTLY MOVING EWD ACROSS NEB...AND THIS IS REFLECTED BY A CLUSTER OF STORMS NOW OVER SWRN NEB. MEANWHILE...ISOLATED STORMS WERE ALSO FORMING OVER S-CNTRL NEB...WHERE ISENTROPIC LIFT WAS INCREASING. A VEERING LOW LEVEL JET SHOULD CONTINUE TO ENHANCE THETA-E ADVECTION ACROSS THE MO VALLEY...AND SEVERAL MODELS INDICATE A NARROW RIBBON OF MODERATE AND UNCAPPED ELEVATED INSTABILITY WILL DEVELOP. THE APPROACHING MIDLEVEL DISTURBANCE SHOULD HELP REINFORCE LIFT WITH A CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS EXPECTED MAINLY OVER ERN NEB. WEAK EFFECTIVE SHEAR SUGGESTS MULTICELLULAR STORM MODE...AND GIVEN STEEP LAPSE RATES ALOFT AND AMPLE MOISTURE...LARGE HAIL MAY OCCUR WITH MAX SIZE AROUND 1.00 TO 1.75 IN DIAMETER.
